# Elite Roofing Solutions

> > Elite Roofing Solutions is a GAF Master Elite roofing contractor serving Texas communities with comprehensive residential and commercial roofing services, specializing in repair, replacement, and storm damage restoration.

Elite Roofing Solutions, Inc. operates across major Texas markets including Houston, New Braunfels, Dallas, and Fort Worth, offering expertise in asphalt shingle, metal, and tile roofing systems. The company maintains certifications with leading manufacturers including GAF, Duro-Last Roofing, and Carlisle, and holds accreditation with the Better Business Bureau and NRCA.
